info.title: PMS Units API
info.description:
The full PMS API is large, as such we have broken down the files into related components. Since some of the components may share model files, models are referenced instead of embedded.

This API covers all endpoints related to unit configuration.

When used externally, this API requires a server context key. 

When used in user context, endpoints may be restricted based on role.

schema.description: In an error situation, we will return a json object with details of the error. This response is based on the following specification: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7807

code.description:

Tax districts are made up of a short and long term policy. Many areas have different set of taxes if a stay exceeds a breakpoint of between 14 - 180 days. If a long term policy does not apply to your area, you can disable the breakpoint.

get.description:
This endpoint will return pricing for the provided unitId.

We recommend that you cache the daily pricing rates on your system and calculate the costs on the fly. Depending on how the system is setup there can be a lot of differences for weekend, seasonal, and other rate changes.

With these cached locally on your system, you will be able to quickly calculate accurate pricing based on the date range requested without additional API calls to TRACK.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: get pricing until this date as ISO 8601 format, defaults to +540 days

Submit a new PUT request to change the clean status of the unit.

After updating the clean status of a unit, the action will be logged to the housekeeping audit log. This log can be viewed on TRACK at {{environment_endpoint}}/reports/housekeeping-audit-log/ (NOTE: not an API endpoint.)

This endpoint for modifying the clean status is the same for POST, PUT and PATCH methods.
